description: Invite someone by email to join your workspace with a role. The invitation link is emailed to them, never returned. Needs an API key sent as x-api-key that holds the team:admin scope, made by someone who is still an owner or admin of the workspace; a token or any other key is refused. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.
name: invite_team_member
